name: Arizona
summary: Statutes: azleg.gov per-section pages are constructible (/ars/{title}/{section zero-padded to 5, '.' -> '-'}.htm) and read cleanly by fetch_doc.py, but robots.txt sets Crawl-delay 120 (two minutes per request); azleg says its online ARS is unofficial (official edition is Thomson Reuters) and shows law effective the following January 1. Justia's 2025 ARS is a constructible tier-2 fallback. Constitution: azleg.gov /const/{article}/{section}.htm. Court rules: the only free official text is Westlaw's govt site (azrules.westgroup.com / govt.westlaw.com/azrules), which refuses automated access; no tier-2 copy exists. Admin Code and Register: apps.azsos.gov chapter/issue PDFs (WebFetch reads them; the shell route is refused by a bot check); Cornell LII mirrors the A.A.C. per section. Case law: Supreme Court opinion PDFs at www.azcourts.gov/Portals/0/OpinionFiles/Supreme/{year}/{docket}.pdf; the Court of Appeals search pages are JavaScript apps with a token-protected API, so Justia (1965-2026, both divisions, memorandum decisions included) is the practical route; apps.azcourts.gov docket PDFs give subsequent history (descendant/predecessor case numbers) while a case is recent.

citation_map.notes: Arizona has no public-domain citation; opinions use numbered paragraphs, and Arizona courts pinpoint by ¶ (e.g. '256 Ariz. 350, ¶ 12 (App. 2023)'), so a slip PDF gives a pinpoint without reporter pages. Arizona style puts Court of Appeals cites as '(App. YYYY)'; Bluebook uses '(Ariz. Ct. App. YYYY)'. 'Ariz. App.' is the closed Arizona Appeals Reports (1965-1976 era, per memory); later Court of Appeals opinions are in 'Ariz.'. Memorandum decisions: from memory, Ariz. R. Sup. Ct. 111(c) allows citing memorandum decisions issued on or after Jan. 1, 2015 for persuasive value, with the docket number, date and '(mem. decision)'; the Justia copies carry the legend 'THIS DECISION IS NOT PRECEDENTIAL AND MAY BE CITED ONLY AS AUTHORIZED BY RULE' (rule text itself not fetched; Westlaw is blocked). 'Petition for review denied' dispositions appear in the subsequent-history parenthetical ('review denied'). Routing guards: bare 'Rule 12(b)(6)', 'Rule 702', 'ER 1.7' and 'Rule 42' must not route here without an 'Ariz.' prefix or Arizona context ('ER' numbering is also used by other states' rules of professional conduct). 'A.R.S.' is unique to Arizona, but 'ARS' alone is a common acronym: route only when followed by a TT-SSS section number. Docket numbers 'CV-24-0143-PR' resemble other states' forms; route on them only with Arizona context; '1 CA-CV' / '2 CA-CR' are Arizona-specific. A '§§ 12-541 to -542' range is two sections: the regex takes the first. Statute URL keys: title unpadded (/ars/1/, /ars/12/); section zero-padded to 5 digits with '.' replaced by '-' (12-341.01 -> /ars/12/00341-01.htm). CourtListener ids from memory, unverified. Constitution Article 4 has parts ('art. IV, pt. 2, § 1'): the regex captures part; the azleg URL form for parts is unverified. Family Law Procedure rules ('Ariz. R. Fam. Law P.', 'ARFLP') route to the blocked Westlaw row.

sources.title: Arizona Revised Statutes (Arizona Legislature)
sources.official_status_evidence: Title index page (https://www.azleg.gov/arsDetail/?title=12): 'The official version of the Arizona Revised Statutes is published by Thomson Reuters.' and the online version is 'primarily maintained for legislative drafting purposes'.
sources.coverage: All ARS titles; one HTML page per section.

access.pattern_rules: title = integer, unpadded, including single-digit titles (/ars/1/, /ars/12/, /ars/41/; /ars/01/00213.htm is 404). section = the part after the hyphen, zero-padded to 5 digits; a decimal point becomes a hyphen and the decimal digits are kept as written: 12-542 -> /ars/12/00542.htm; 13-1105 -> /ars/13/01105.htm; 12-341.01 -> /ars/12/00341-01.htm; 41-1092.01 -> /ars/41/01092-01.htm. The bare .htm page is the section text only (no navigation); the wrapper https://www.azleg.gov/viewdocument/?docName=https://www.azleg.gov/ars/{title}/{section}.htm serves the same text with site chrome and the currency banner.
access.navigation: Title index lists every chapter WITH section ranges ('Chapter 5 LIMITATIONS OF ACTIONS Sec: 12-501-12-559.03') and every section as a viewdocument link; not needed for URL construction.

automation.robots_txt: User-agent * — Crawl-delay: 120; disallows /search/, /xml/, /FormatDocument.asp, /FormatForPrint.asp, /DocumentsForBill.asp, WordPress paths; /ars/, /arsDetail/, /viewdocument/, /const/ allowed
automation.notes: Script (fetch_doc.py) is the primary route. WebFetch is gated: constructed /ars/ URLs need a permission approval and fail with PROVENANCE_REQUIRED; only URLs surfaced by a prior search/fetch (e.g. the viewdocument wrapper for 22-101 from the title-22 index) were fetched. Crawl-delay 120 s: plan one azleg request per citation.
